description: Key-ascending appends into the primary-key index of IxL (598 Long keys 1..598): six single inserts, 599 to 604, crossing 602 entries. Asks at which insert the index leaf changes shape (a split, a new page, a root change) and what each earlier insert changes. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it.
